quarterly_data.quarter: Giantec Semiconductor results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual collective (04-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: General manager Zhang Jianchen (2025 annual collective results briefing): the VPD chips developed for new-generation eSSD and CXL memory modules have taped out, samples meet the product specification and process stability supports volume production, and small-batch samples have been sent to the target customer on schedule for performance and application testing. As a fabless company, its outsourced suppliers are mainly globally known, domestically leading listed companies with advanced processes and ample capacity reserves.
